bio: Research Overview Publications Contact Us Comparative genomics with a focus on aging and age-related diseases, leveraging natural examples of exceptional longevity to decipher mechanisms facilitating senescence resistance. Animals that resist the rigors of time well past a human lifespan, that maintain health and function for centuries, will inform therapies to delay and/or prevent aging and age-related diseases in people. The Function and Regulation of celsr1a in Skeletal Age-associated Homeostasis and Repair in Zebrafish. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci. 2025 06 10; 80(7).
